description: 3000 load samples for paper "Component Analysis and Accuracy Improvement of Linear Power Flow Equation based on Legendre Polynomial Expansion is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Zhexin Fan, Zhifang Yang. This document aims to provide 3000 samples (1000 for each test system) of IEEE 30, 118 and Polish 2383 benchmark systems with 20% load fluctuation. The baseline physical parameters of the power system are recorded in MATPOWER 6.0. 3000 samples are generated by applying random fluctuations between 0-20% to the baseline load on all buses. Coverage: national (PL); the metadata date the deposit to 2022. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 53947478 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
